title: Not Even Subscribing to Cboe Data Makes GEX Viable for Predictions
text: TBT is a data set that gives better transaction level detail for action on the C1 exchange, unlike summary level products such as open close, which aggregate volume by participant. Position TBT captures each individual trade event with full contact. So, the data set includes timestamps, underlying OSI and OSI details, trade price and size, buy and sell, open close indicators, participant capacity, and trade type classifications along with market context such as MBBO and so on and so forth. And the problem though is that Cboe and ICE combined, the entire exchanges are 37% of volume. We effectively are looking at aggregate noisy level estimates. That's what this boils down to. You have no insight into the entire dealer book.
